'''Omisha Joyo''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Clan of the Toribota]] from the [[Planet|world]] of [[Isde Naha]]. His nomadic enclave settled on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] and in [[1 BBY]] he crossed paths with the [[Guardians of the Whills]] [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] agents [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] several [[time]]s in the streets and markets of [[Jedha City]].

He then witnessed Îmwe confront a group of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s in a [[city]] square shortly before Jedha City was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].

==Biography==
===In the light of the First Star===
The [[human]] Omisha Joyo was a member of nomadic enclave known as the [[Clan of the Toribota]], which hailed from<ref name="UVG" /> his<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[homeworld]] of [[Isde Naha]].<ref name="Geektionary French" /> Astronomical conjecture<ref name="UVG" /> and the calculations of [[scientist]]s led the group to believe that the [[star]] of the [[Jedha system]] was the [[First Light (star)|First Light]], the first primitive star seen by their ancestors. This led the clan to settle on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] in the [[Star system|system]], site of [[Jedha City]].<ref name="Geektionary" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' and [[Rogue One Adaptation 1|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 1]] to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Joyo stood in the streets of Jedha [[City]] near the [[Guardians of the Whills]] [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]] as Îmwe chanted about [[the Force]].<ref name="RO1">[[Rogue One Adaptation 1|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 1]]</ref> Soon after, Joyo passed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] agents [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] in one of the city's markets<ref name="RO2">[[Rogue One Adaptation 2|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 2]]</ref> and then crossed paths with another individual dressed in an identical [[Clothing|outfit]] to him near where Erso first encountered Îmwe in the market.<ref name="Rogue One" />

===In the shadow of the Death Star===
[[File:LoscarUbrentoJoyo-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Omisha Joyo witnessed Chirrut Îmwe confront Imperial stormtroopers.]]
Following an [[Battle on Jedha|ambush]] of [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] by the rebel [[partisans]] in the city's [[Tythoni Square]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> Joyo<ref name="Geektionary" /> stood with a group of civilians on the side of a different square where [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s were questioning various citizens. After the Imperials took Erso and Andor captive, Îmwe entered the square through an arch way behind Joyo and walked past him to confront the stormtroopers. Joyo and the others then scattered as a fight broke out between the Imperials and the Guardian of the Whills.<ref name="Rogue One" />

The Empire then evacuated its forces from Jedha City and [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] the entire settlement with the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> which unfortunately the mystical cosmology of the Clan of the Toribota had not forseen.<ref name="Geektionary" />

==Personality and traits==
Omisha Joyo had [[Color|tan]] skin.<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Equipment==
Omisha Joyo wore a blue robe and a resonant gray [[helmet]] that siphoned the call of the First Light,<ref name="UVG" /> acting as a receiver to the signal emitted by the primitive light, which was essential to his people.<ref name="Geektionary" /> He carried an ancient gray distillery for the purification of potable [[water]] in a harness across his chest and also possessed a gray [[club]]-like device.<ref name="UVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JedhaExtrasVersion5A.png|thumb|right|200px|"Jedha Extras version 5A"]]
Omisha Joyo first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Concept art including Joyo and the other individual wearing the same outfit titled "Jedha Extras version 5A" was drawn for the film by costume concept designer [[Adam Brockbank]].<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Prior to the film's release, Joyo was first revealed in the film's first full trailer,<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|frdj1zb9sMY|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-trailer}}</ref> which was first aired on [[August 11]], 2016.<ref name="TrailerDate">{{SW|url=news/9-highlights-from-the-rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-trailer|text=9 Highlights from the ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Trailer|nolive=1}}</ref> The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="UVG" /> Joyo is drawn with orange robes instead of blue in the [[Rogue One Adaptation 1|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Rogue One Adaptation|comic adaptation]] of ''Rogue One'', which was written by [[Jody Houser]], illustrated by [[Emilio Laiso]] and [[Jan Bazaldúa]], and published on [[May 3]], [[2017]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/63605/star_wars_rogue_one_adaptation_2017_2|text=Star Wars: Rogue One Adaptation (2017) #2}}</ref>
